## Summary

Describe the user-facing change and any repository types affected.

## Validation

- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passes
- [ ] Added tests for new behavior or explained why not applicable
- [ ] Checked preview/doctor/catalog remain read-only
- [ ] Checked no existing file or personal/global setting is changed unexpectedly
- [ ] Updated the docs, notes, and changelog as appropriate

## Safety and privacy impact

What files does this read or write? Any subprocess/network activity? Does it touch existing instructions, MCP configs, hooks, or secrets?

## Evidence

Link a reproducible test or benchmark. Mark author claims, independent evidence, and hypotheses distinctly.
